sources.title: GitHub - ostadabbas/ViMoLa: ViMoLa: Discrete Motion Tokens for Language ...
sources.snippet: ViMoLa (Video Motion Language) predicts discrete motion tokens from text and injects them into a frozen Wan 2.2 image-to-video backbone. Language is the only interface at inference — no tracks, drags, or camera paths.
